text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It happened when training with Daiichi Ruby's friends using the VR Umulator—

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Thank you all for your cooperation.
If you will excuse me, my next appointment is approaching, so I must take my leave.

text_block_list.name: Grandiose Voice
text_block_list.text:
"—Bzzzt. Chosen six heroes!
If you wish to leave this place, heed my command!"

text_block_list.name: Grandiose Voice
text_block_list.text:
"‘Attention! You are now trapped in VR space!
If you want to log out, join forces and clear every trial I'm about to give you! *Bzzzt*’"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh! What's that!?
A game!? Like an escape room kind of thing!?

text_block_list.name: Grandiose Voice
text_block_list.text:
"Your first challenge is—anyone will do!
You can't leave until you shout a gag out loud!"

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Huh? An assignment? A gag...?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Wait, who the heck are you?!
Who gave you permission to butt in like that?!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...Dad says, 'You shall not pass!'

text_block_list.name: Miracle & Bamboo
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Gonna go to the river with someone cute.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I attempted to contact the outside earlier,
but it was impossible. We cannot expect rescue.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: In that case, there is no choice but to work through the tasks.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I see. ...Though a whirlwind it is. To think you knew a gag like that...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: My father did it a few times when I was little. He wanted to lighten the mood for my mother and me.

text_block_list.name: Ruby's Father
text_block_list.text:
"You and Ruby should get some rest for today.
Dad's not gonna let you into the lesson room—get it, 'Dad's not' sound like 'passage closed'~?
...J-Just kidding, hahaha."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Even though he's an incredible person working as a politician's secretary...
Hehe. Ruby's father is truly kind, isn't he?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Now then, present the next assignment.
I have plans, so please make it quick.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah, totally!
Let's all work together and get outta here!

text_block_list.name: Grandiose Voice
text_block_list.text:
"‘Next task! Everyone must participate!
You cannot leave until you blow a kiss with all your might!’"

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...Next.

text_block_list.name: Grandiose Voice
text_block_list.text:
"‘Next task! Work together in pairs!
You can't leave unless you cast magic on the cake!
The incantation is—’"

text_block_list.name: Helios & Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Make it delicious~ ♡
Moe moe... kyun! ♡

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Moe moe... kyun!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Next.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Even after that, unreasonable demands kept coming—imitating a gorilla, catching frogs—but...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Next.

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: I-I made it out~!
choice_data_list: Thank goodness...! I'm really so glad!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Fufu.
Successful escape, reporting in as the auspicious wind~♪

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ayy ayy ayy!
We're the absolute best, ayyâ

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If not for Daiichi Ruby speaking up first,
I surely wouldn't have been able to escape right away.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
――Well then.
My next appointment is approaching, so I will take my leave.
choice_data_list: (...That was a quick shift in mood!)

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Whaaat!? You're leaving already, Miss Fancy!?
Let's hit the after-party! Time to get hyped!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
No. After cooling down, I have language study
and press interviews lined up.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Ruby really is so straightforward.
Just don't push yourself too hard, okay?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
No problem at all.
Trainer is here with me, after all.
choice_data_list: …! Ah, let's move on to the next one right away!
…! Yeah, let's move on to the next one right away!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Everyone. Once again, I would like to express my sincere gratitude
for your cooperation with today's training.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Now then, please excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Following behind the departing Daiichi Ruby,
I couldn't help but admire her resolute, unwavering stride once more.
